Missing conjugation, wrong interference sign and injected dark intensity are all rejected.
Current-run checks pass for all nine optical profiles without imposing the source-only law on a crystal.
Source 2D, complex BP and degenerate MoS2 examples pass their applicable checking procedures.
Large coefficient scale passes the norm/completeness audit with a scale-aware tolerance.
Actual tampering is detected: altered plotted point, reflected frame and wrong return QWP all fail.
The existing 21 model checks and all new source-reference procedures pass together.
The result ZIP contains identical UI/export evidence in JSON and Markdown, with unchanged scientific figure formats.

source.notation: R[out,in]: first index = detected circular label; second = incident label.
source.scope: The source is an effective complex 2x2 optical model. Its antisymmetric off-diagonal pair is not substituted for a D2h material tensor.

rows.title: Circular-basis orthonormality
rows.purpose: Exclude incorrect normalization and missing complex conjugation.
rows.procedure: Form the Gram matrix of the two circular vectors.

rows.title: Explicit quarter-wave-plate matrix
rows.purpose: Detect an axis-angle or retardance sign error before scattering.
rows.procedure: Compare the implemented plate with the matrix printed in the source.

rows.title: Lossless and symmetric plate
rows.purpose: Check norm preservation by this ideal plate and its symmetry in the adopted basis.
rows.procedure: Compute Q dagger Q and Q transpose. This is not a unitarity requirement on the Raman tensor.

rows.title: Incident circular state
rows.purpose: Confirm the selected plate actually prepares the intended incident state.
rows.procedure: Propagate x-polarized input and compare vectors including the unit global phase.

rows.title: General circular amplitudes
rows.purpose: Check the output-input index order and the signs of all Cartesian entries.
rows.procedure: Contract a general complex 2x2 tensor and compare independent entry formulas.

rows.title: Modified source tensor
rows.purpose: Verify the extra yy phase and the cancellation of antisymmetric off-diagonal entries in the flipped channel.
rows.procedure: Substitute the source tensor into the circular contractions.

rows.title: Scattered-field reconstruction
rows.purpose: Ensure no circular amplitude is lost before return propagation.
rows.procedure: Compare Cartesian scattering with its complete circular expansion.

rows.title: Return plate and physical angle zero
rows.purpose: Detect a wrong return matrix or an arbitrary analyzer reference that would rotate or mirror a plot.
rows.procedure: Reconstruct the two returned circular states, their real axes and their relative phase.

rows.title: Analyzer endpoint calibration
rows.purpose: Establish what alpha=0 and alpha=90 degrees detect in this optical chain.
rows.procedure: Transmit each returned circular state through both calibrated analyzer endpoints.

rows.title: Matrix chain versus circular amplitude
rows.purpose: Check matrix ordering and the relative phase that sets the interference sign.
rows.procedure: Compare the production amplitude with the independent circular-channel expansion.

rows.title: Three intensity pieces
rows.purpose: Identify an incorrect complex conjugate or an incorrect sign in the interference term.
rows.procedure: Independently evaluate the two powers and Im(R++ R-+ conjugate).

rows.title: Symbolic squared-modulus identity
rows.purpose: Prove the hand formula agrees with the matrix result without inserting it into the plotting engine.
rows.procedure: Reduce the symbolic difference between A times A conjugate and the source closed form to zero.

rows.title: Seeded numerical intensity comparison
rows.purpose: Cross-check symbolic processing against independent complex NumPy propagation.
rows.procedure: Repeat the source's four seed-1 parameter samples, then 64 phase/sign/zero cases.

rows.title: Fourier reconstruction
rows.purpose: Check the harmonic representation used to determine continuous extrema.
rows.procedure: Reconstruct the intensity from independently derived constant, cosine and sine coefficients.

rows.title: Old-tensor limit
rows.purpose: Recover the earlier model when the new relative yy phase vanishes.
rows.procedure: Set phi=0 and compare the complete angular law, not only one angle.

rows.title: Diagonal-tensor phase limit
rows.purpose: Check that a relative diagonal phase shifts the analyzer pattern with the correct sign.
rows.procedure: Set A=0 and compare with the independently shifted cosine law.

rows.title: Pure flipped-channel limit
rows.purpose: Confirm extinction of the same-label channel in a known limiting tensor.
rows.procedure: Set A=0 and phi=pi.

rows.title: All four circular channels
rows.purpose: Check both input labels and prevent interchange of incident and detected indices.
rows.procedure: Derive all four circular amplitudes and compare their squared moduli with the source formulas.

rows.title: Four channels through real optical chains
rows.purpose: Validate the physical preparation and detection path rather than relying only on a basis transform.
rows.procedure: Prepare each input with its own +/-45-degree plate and compare same/flip endpoint powers; use the source's five seed-5 samples plus a zero case.

rows.title: Circular-input difference and dissymmetry
rows.purpose: Check the source's contrast definition and its denominator; do not infer material chirality from this algebraic test.
rows.procedure: Subtract complete powers for the two incident labels and compare the analytic difference.
rows.assumption: CID is defined only when a^2+A^2>0; its formula uses the source's fixed-lab convention.

rows.title: Zero-contrast limits
rows.purpose: Detect a spurious circular-input difference in limiting cases where it must vanish.
rows.procedure: Substitute A=0, phi=pi and delta=phi/2 separately into the computed difference.

rows.title: Alternative-convention mirror check
rows.purpose: Identify a documented change of optical convention without forcing different experiments to share one curve.
rows.procedure: Use the appendix return plate and lab-x analyzer, then compare with the main source law at -alpha.
rows.expected_latex: I_{\rm appendix}(\alpha)=I_{\rm main}(-\alpha)\quad\text{for the declared source tensor}

rows.title: Angular periodicity
rows.purpose: Ensure that the plotted first-harmonic amplitude gives a 180-degree intensity period.
rows.procedure: Translate the source scan by pi and reduce the difference symbolically.

rows.title: Dark source and undefined contrast
rows.purpose: Avoid reporting a finite dissymmetry for a completely dark source.
rows.procedure: Set a=A=0 and require all powers to vanish while CID is explicitly undefined.

rows.title: Deliberately incorrect controls
rows.purpose: Demonstrate that the checker can detect conjugation, interference-sign and intensity errors.
rows.procedure: Require rejection of three injected mistakes at declared nontrivial parameters.

reference.scope: Reference identities and implementation checks. Passing does not certify material coefficients, experimental propagation or chirality.
reference.notation_note: Cells 6-11 intermittently call <sigma-|R|sigma+> R+-; this report consistently writes R-+. The contracted vector, not the ambiguous label, defines the channel.
